backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies. Forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: add a 5d early replacement-confirmation scalar only to official Space tickers whose mature 5d profile is both cash-positive and same-theme replacement-positive.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260513-113 accepted 10d cash-positive plus same-theme-positive risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-009 accepted the 10d same-theme strength trend-only interaction at 1.05x.
LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin, so this uses structured forward ledger outcomes instead.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the 5d confirmation risk scalar changes; entries, exits, ranking, targets, LLM/news, tickers, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, and real adjusted signals.

hypothesis: Space forward replacement alpha may appear first at the 5-trading-day horizon before the accepted 10d profile fully closes. Official non-attention Space tickers with positive 5d cash-relative and same-theme replacement value may deserve an incremental default-off risk allocation on top of the accepted exp-20260514-009 stack.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
The 5d profile is a short-horizon forward signal and can conflict with the accepted 10d profile.
Accepted results would still be observation metadata, not live Space slot enablement.
next_evidence_needed: Do not promote 5d confirmation risk from this frozen replay. Use more closed forward rows or a different catalyst-quality axis.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

rejection_reason: No tested 5d confirmation scalar improved aggregate EV/PnL across the three windows without a window-level EV regression, drawdown or survival violation, or zero-adjustment result.
single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for official Space tickers whose mature 5d forward event-state profile is cash-positive and same-theme replacement-positive
variants: <stripped 295KB oversized field; full value retained in the experiment artifact>
why_not_other_changes: Noisy Space ticker expansion and LLM soft-ranking remain blocked by sample quality. Nearby 10d same-theme scalar/floor retunes should wait for new closed evidence, so this tests a different forward horizon using the same structured ledger.
